withdrawn.name: i18n-catalogues

resolution.reason: The catalogue files are JSON and carry no exported component, so `sdrive verify` cannot match them by symbol or by bare file name. Their content was delivered: ds.* keys were added to all three locales together, and scripts/check-locale-parity.mjs is wired into `build` to prove the catalogues keep the same shape.

withdrawn.name: DesignTokens

resolution.reason: DesignTokens is a conceptual name for a plain as-const object, deliberately not persisted or declared as a TS type: the plan itself specifies no runtime type and the file exports the groups individually. It shipped as backoffice/src/design-system/tokens.ts (color, font, radius, space, elevation) with no type/interface declaration for a detector to read.

withdrawn.name: LocaleCatalogue

resolution.reason: LocaleCatalogue is a conceptual name for the three JSON message files, not a declared entity, so there is no interface whose fields could be detected. The update was delivered: ds.* keys now exist in en, ar and fr, and the 135 pre-existing keys are unchanged, which scripts/check-locale-parity.mjs asserts on every build.
